summary: The execution plan fits the approved Electron desktop scope and contains no concrete blocking flaw. Installed @opencode/client 2.0.18 declarations support the required session.get, session.update, session.fork and session.remove shapes, including title/permissions updates and SessionInfo location/parent data. Main-process ownership, explicitly temporary pin/archive/diagnostic state, archive execution guards, idle/known/locked checks, unknown-outcome handling, non-evicting idempotency receipts, native-confirmed conversation deletion with project-file preservation, bounded redacted diagnostics, regression/native/package checks, sequencing and disjoint backend/renderer ownership are specified. Permanent retention and native Windows evidence remain parent limits. This verdict approves the execution plan only; the separately bound design-spec gate for interface.md still follows registration.
